description: Debt service coverage ratio of a rental, two ways: NOI divided by yearly principal and interest, and the figure DSCR-loan lenders use on 1-4 unit rentals, scheduled rent divided by PITIA (payment plus tax, insurance and HOA). The two definitions give different numbers for the same property, which is why quotes of a DSCR often disagree; both are labelled in the answer. With target_dscr, rate_pct and amort_years the answer also sizes the largest loan the NOI supports. Send noi and annual_debt_service, plus gross_rent_annual, annual_tax, annual_insurance and annual_hoa for the lender figure. Zero debt service is refused: with no debt, DSCR does not exist.

amort_years.description: Amortization in years, e.g. 30, for the largest loan

annual_debt_service.description: Principal and interest paid per year, e.g. 22000

annual_hoa.description: HOA dues per year, e.g. 0, for the lender figure

annual_insurance.description: Insurance per year, e.g. 1800, for the lender figure

annual_tax.description: Property tax per year, e.g. 3600, for the lender figure

gross_rent_annual.description: Scheduled rent per year, e.g. 38400, for the lender rent-to-PITIA figure

noi.description: Net operating income per year, e.g. 28000

rate_pct.description: Loan interest rate in percent, e.g. 7.25, for the largest loan

target_dscr.description: Lender minimum DSCR, e.g. 1.25, to size the largest loan

name: compute_dscr
title: Debt service coverage ratio (DSCR)
